newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Davignon group to report in May on Euro company statutes.
newsitem.headline: Davignon group to report in May on Euro company statutes.

text.p: A group of labour experts is due in May to recommend a way out of the deadlock among EU governments over draft laws that would allow firms to set up as European companies rather than national ones.

Dutch Employment Minister Ad Melkert told reporters on Thursday he hoped European Union social affairs ministers would reach conclusions on June 12 on the findings of the expert group, chaired by former European Commissioner Etienne Davignon.
The European Company Statute, first proposed by the Commission 20 years ago, has been blocked by a conflict over its provisions on worker participation in company decisions.
The conflict has also blocked the proposed European Association, the European Mutual Society, the European Cooperative Society and the Fifth Company Law Directive.
